name: The seven factors of awakening arising in sequence (MN 118)

stages.name: sati-sambojjhaṅga
stages.description: unmuddled mindfulness is established while he abides contemplating (body, feelings, mind or dhammas)

stages.name: dhammavicaya-sambojjhaṅga
stages.description: arises as he investigates that dhamma with wisdom, examines it and undertakes scrutiny

stages.name: vīriya-sambojjhaṅga
stages.description: arises in one investigating thus: energy aroused and unflagging

stages.name: pīti-sambojjhaṅga
stages.description: arises in one whose energy is aroused: unworldly rapture

stages.name: passaddhi-sambojjhaṅga
stages.description: arises in one whose mind is rapt: body and mind become tranquil

stages.name: samādhi-sambojjhaṅga
stages.description: arises in one whose body is tranquil and who is happy: the mind is concentrated

stages.name: upekkha-sambojjhaṅga
stages.description: arises as he looks on with equanimity at the mind thus concentrated

name: The sixteen steps of mindfulness of breathing (MN 118)

stages.name: step 1
stages.description: Breathing in long he knows 'I breathe in long'; breathing out long he knows 'I breathe out long' (knowing, pajānāti).

stages.name: step 2
stages.description: Breathing in short he knows 'I breathe in short'; breathing out short he knows 'I breathe out short'.

stages.name: step 3
stages.description: He trains: 'I shall breathe in (out) experiencing the whole body'.

stages.name: step 4
stages.description: He trains: 'I shall breathe in (out) calming the bodily formation'.

stages.name: step 5
stages.description: He trains: 'I shall breathe in (out) experiencing rapture'.

stages.name: step 6
stages.description: He trains: 'I shall breathe in (out) experiencing pleasure'.

stages.name: step 7
stages.description: He trains: 'I shall breathe in (out) experiencing the mental formation'.

stages.name: step 8
stages.description: He trains: 'I shall breathe in (out) calming the mental formation'.

stages.name: step 9
stages.description: He trains: 'I shall breathe in (out) experiencing the mind'.

stages.name: step 10
stages.description: He trains: 'I shall breathe in (out) gladdening the mind'.

stages.name: step 11
stages.description: He trains: 'I shall breathe in (out) concentrating the mind'.

stages.name: step 12
stages.description: He trains: 'I shall breathe in (out) liberating the mind'.

stages.name: step 13
stages.description: He trains: 'I shall breathe in (out) contemplating impermanence'.

stages.name: step 14
stages.description: He trains: 'I shall breathe in (out) contemplating fading away (dispassion)'.

stages.name: step 15
stages.description: He trains: 'I shall breathe in (out) contemplating cessation'.

stages.name: step 16
stages.description: He trains: 'I shall breathe in (out) contemplating relinquishment'.
